chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 250 – Gouwa’s Big Win & Li Huowang’s Secret
chapter_meta_description: Gouwa nearly chokes to death on his own trick, then charms the ladies. But the real horror is watching Li Huowang head toward a tent that isn’t the Black Tai Sui’s.
og_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Chapter 250 – Success
og_description: A rare moment of levity in the Dao-Twisted World: Gouwa’s blow-dart triumph turns into a flirting victory, while Li Huowang sharpens his tools and heads for a mysterious tent.
twitter_description: Gouwa nearly dies on his own trick, then lands a date. Meanwhile, Li Huowang ignores the Black Tai Sui tent and heads somewhere else.

lore_anchors.definition: A specialized implement used to channel or unleash supernatural power. In xianxia, even a simple object like a tube and a needle can qualify if treated with ritual significance.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is Gouwa so scared of swallowing the needle?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The needle is a physical object imbued with supernatural properties—swallowing it wouldn't just choke him, it could transform him into a monster, just as Senior Brother Li feared previously.
The grumpy patriarch of a small traveling opera troupe. He trusts Li Huowang's supernatural judgment and relies on his son Lü Xiucai to gauge the cultivator's mood before asking for favors.
